status: labels for configs/sensor_failure_tuning_v5.json; same protocol as sensor-failure-model-v2 (Q 24 h, W 10 min, daily 00:00 cutoffs, same exclusions and Q shadow)

connection_loss_ge2s.label: connection_loss
connection_loss_ge2s.role: the threshold the user means ('>= 2 s'); target of the stage 1 fits
connection_loss_ge2s.note: with 1 s timestamps this adds the episodes of exactly 2 s to the > 2 s target

connection_loss_gt2s.label: connection_loss
connection_loss_gt2s.note: > 2 s means >= 3 s at 1 s resolution

episode_filter_rule: an episode qualifies if the filter is null, it is open at data end, or date_diff('second', start_at, end_at) satisfies the filter
